## Information
This angel comes in a beautiful sparkling silver dress with white feathered wings. Featuring glitter and white lace detail this Angel gives the perfect finish to your tree. Simple and easy to use, the angel simply slots onto the top of your tree with its hidden cone design which is securely placed under the angels dress. With a generous size, this angel has a versatile use for many assorted sizes and designed trees both real and artificial.
